rows.label: ex:wild_cantor_general_antoine
rows.notes: Correctly left unmarked in the module docstring. The row's claim GX.antoineNecklace_not_isSLSCInCC (literal, DEC-55, through GX.sphere3_isSLSCInCC_compl_iff for closed C) is derived without sorry from the residual alone, via GX.antoineNecklace_not_isSLSCInCC_of. I checked that the residual is TRUE and not vacuous. The meridian (circle of radius 3/14 around (0,7/8,0) in the plane x = 0) misses L: where |z| ≤ 1/8, |y − 7/8| ≥ 0.174 > 1/8, and GX.antoineMeridian_not_mem proves it. It is essential in S³ ∖ L. For m > n, C_m ∩ L_n is exactly the descendants of L_n, because generation-n links are disjoint (GX.antoineMap_disjoint) and the stages are nested. The first-stage chain interlocks: the right bar of a type-0 ring at x ∈ [c+0.0656, c+0.0875] passes through the hole x ∈ (c+0.0437, c+0.175) of the next type-1 ring, and conversely. The chain closes up (16·70 = 1120 = 2·560, GX.antoine_adj_succ). So the residual is Antoine's classical lemma: the meridian of T is essential in the complement of a linked chain going around T, iterated, with the self-similar statement for generation n. The tag correctly explains why the dispatch's abelian/ℤ₂ route cannot work: the meridian of L is 0 in H₁ of the finite-stage complement. The sorry is genuine and was seriously attempted: every reduction around it is built. It is the ONE named residual the dispatch allowed, so 'stated' is the honest status.
